verdict.rationale: Jira's own Rovo AI is documented to create automations and to break down ideas into tasks that it assigns automatically. An official MCP server and CLI also let AI agents act on Jira. None of the evidence explicitly says users can issue natural-language commands to operate the product, so the depth of conversational control is unproven. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of natural-language command operation across core actions (create, update, transition, query), any hands-on or independent corroboration, and detail on what Rovo can execute from a prompt.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Use Rovo AI to create custom automations to keep your status up to date - from automated reminders to rules that move work forward.
Breakdown big ideas into actionable tasks and automatically assign them to the right person with Rovo AI.
Assign work to your favorite coding agent from Jira or bring context to your AI stack with our MCP and CLI.
